warnings.message: nothing pins one npm for the repository (packageManager, devEngines, Volta or .tool-versions), and npm 11.16.0 to 11.19.1 (with Node.js 24 in .nvmrc) run dependency install scripts that allowScripts does not cover unless strict-allow-scripts is set, so depcurfew apply writes strict-allow-scripts=true; with it, in npm 12.0.0 and later the install fails instead of blocking the script with a warning
warnings.fix: Make every place listed here run npm 12.0.0 or later (npm install -g npm@12.0.0 before it installs packages; a pin in packageManager or devEngines does not change the npm they run), and depcurfew apply leaves strict-allow-scripts out. Until then, review the packages an install stops at and add them to installScripts.allow or installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: the npm that comes with Node.js of node@sha256:4f1d2b5c0a9e8f7d6c5b4a3928170615f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a392817061 in apps/web/Containerfile (depcurfew cannot tell which one: the image is pinned by digest only (node@sha256:4f1d2b5c0a9e8f7d6c5b4a3928170615f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a392817061)) may run every dependency install script, so depcurfew counts it as one that does, and "deny" may not be enforced there
warnings.fix: Declare a Node.js version depcurfew knows there (an exact release it knows or a release line such as 24), or install npm 11.16.0 or later before packages are installed there (npm install -g npm@11.16.0); npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default

warnings.message: npm 10.5.1 to 10.9.9 (with Node.js 22 of node:22-alpine in Dockerfile), npm 11.3.0 to 11.13.0 (with Node.js 24 in .nvmrc) and npm 10.9.0 (with Node.js v22.11.0 in .node-version) run every dependency install script and have no allow-list, so "deny" cannot be enforced there
warnings.fix: Install npm 11.16.0 or later before packages are installed there (npm install -g npm@11.16.0), or move to a Node.js release that comes with it; npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default

warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow
